text: Heaven also sent a great crow, Yatagarasu, which guided the army through wild mountains all the way to Yamato.
spoken: Heaven also sent a great crow, Yah-tah-gah-rah-soo, which guided the army through wild mountains all the way to Yah-mah-toh.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
